name: El Paso Museum of Art
scope: The two-storey El Paso Museum of Art at One Arts Festival Plaza in its 2011 photographed appearance. Includes the beige entrance panels, recessed glazed entrance, blue glazed wing and mapped western curve and gallery envelope. Plaza artworks, neighboring buildings, exhibits and later renovations are outside the asset.

references.filename: El Paso Museum of Art. El Paso, Texas.jpg

originalReview.notes: The native photograph shows the pale rectangular panel rhythm, paired glazed doors and transoms, two-storey dark window grid, sheltered corner overhang and blue wall panels on the plaza side. Reflected architecture and incidental fixtures are outside the model.

review.method: Published Qualla file, matched Commons native SHA-1 and explicit photographer public-domain dedication
review.notes: One exact published Qualla exterior reference was accepted. Its photographer dates it only to 2011. The indoor sculpture photograph was excluded.
